theorem.base_interpolation: On X, L(x)=Q(x).  Since |X|=m and deg(L-Q)<m, this forces L=Q.
theorem.direction_exclusion: On Y, z L(y)=Q(y)=L(y).  If z!=1 then L vanishes on six direction nodes; but L=Q has degree <|S|-t<=5, hence L=0.
theorem.endpoint: The endpoint-uniform dependency gives the single projective endpoint [0:1].
theorem.kernel_equation: At finite slope z, a kernel polynomial L of degree <m gives weighted values omega_s L(s) on X and z omega_y L(y) on Y.  The dual Vandermonde nullspace is omega_s Q(s) with deg Q<|S|-t.
theorem.root_existence: At z=1, every nonzero Q with deg Q<|S|-t gives a kernel polynomial, so z=1 is present with kernel dimension |S|-t.
theorem.split_filter: The split-filter dependency proves this z=1 kernel contains no monic degree-j divisor of X^512-1.
theorem.statement: For the boundary barycentric rank-6 family at A=385,386,387, the ambient finite regular root table is exactly {1}.  That root is filtered by the split-locator gate, so the finite support-wise split-locator contribution is 0 and the only support-wise projective contribution in this family is [0:1].
